title: BC Friday Tips #62 VS Code AL Themes
summary: The AL Language extension in VS Code includes built-in themes called Business Central Light and Business Central Dark available since version 16.00 to improve code readability and reduce eye strain.
key_points: Business Central Light and Dark themes are available in the AL Language extension
Themes have been available since AL version 16.00
Custom themes improve readability and reduce eye strain during development
Theme selection helps developers match their personal preferences

quotes.text: AL Language extension in VS Code has its own themes
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a built-in capability developers may not know about

quotes.text: Better readability. Less eye strain. A look that fits your preference.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the practical benefits for developer comfort and productivity
